prompts.title: Geometric Vector Portrait of a Man
prompts.prompt:
Create a stylized low-poly digital illustration of a confident man, shown in a dramatic close-up portrait from the chest up. He has thick, natural dark hair, deep-set eyes. His head is held straight with no tilt, maintaining a calm, serious, and confident expression while looking directly at the viewer.
Use a faceted polygonal art style, with sharp geometric shapes and layered angular planes defining the face, hair, neck, and clothing. Keep the facial proportions natural and highly recognizable if using a reference image. Render the skin in detailed monochromatic shades ranging from pure white and light gray to medium gray and deep charcoal, with strong geometric highlights and defined shadows for a bold, sculptural appearance.
He is wearing a black crew-neck shirt underneath a dark charcoal/black blazer, with angular folds and simplified geometric detailing.
The background should be bold graphic red, featuring dramatic black, dark-gray, and white sharp diagonal brush-like shapes and streaks radiating behind the subject, creating an energetic comic-book/editorial aesthetic. Use high contrast, crisp edges, minimal gradients, and clean vector-like shapes.
Composition: centered symmetrical portrait, head and shoulders dominant, slightly low camera angle, tight framing, strong visual presence.
Style: premium low-poly portrait, geometric vector illustration, modern editorial poster, bold graphic design, high contrast, ultra-detailed facial facets, sharp clean edges, dramatic lighting, 16K quality, no text, no watermark.
Aspect ratio 4:5

prompts.title: Vectored Intensity
prompts.prompt:
Create a 4:5 vertical high-contrast vector portrait illustration of a male subject, shown in a dramatic low-angle close-up bust composition. The subject fills most of the frame from the upper chest upward. His face is viewed from below, with the chin raised, neck strongly visible, and head turned slightly toward the viewer’s right. His eyes look upward in the same direction with a serious, calm, aspirational expression.
The composition must feel dynamic and slightly asymmetrical, not perfectly centered or front-facing. Preserve the strong low-angle perspective, sharp jawline, elevated chin, and powerful upward gaze.

Art Style & Rendering
Render the portrait in a premium modern vector pop-art / WPAP-inspired style, using sharp-edged geometric grayscale planes to build the face, neck, and clothing. The shading should be faceted, angular, and high-contrast, with clear polygon-like tonal blocks in white, light gray, mid-gray, dark gray, charcoal, and black. Keep the facial rendering detailed and semi-realistic, not simplified comic art.

No soft blending, no smooth painterly gradients.
Face & Hair
The face should have a sculpted angular structure, detailed eyes, defined brows, realistic nose and lips, and dramatic shadow under the jaw. The underside of the chin and neck should feature deep black and charcoal geometric shadow blocks. If beard is present make it defined.

Hair should be thick, messy, energetic, and sharply jagged, formed from irregular black and dark-gray vector strokes, with a natural chaotic shape rather than neat anime-style spikes.
Clothing
The subject wears a dark crew-neck t-shirt layered under a dark open collared shirt, visible only in the lower portion of the portrait. Keep the clothing simple and secondary to the face, rendered in charcoal, black, and dark gray tones with sharp angular vector folds and high-contrast geometric shading. The clothing should not alter the head angle, neck prominence, portrait framing, or overall composition.

Add a small minimal white generic symbol emblem at the center of the upper chest, placed on the visible t-shirt.
Outline / Edge Glow
Add a bold rough electric-red rim outline around the subject’s outer silhouette, especially along the hair, ear, shoulders, and collar. The outline should feel like a strong graphic edge glow, slightly uneven and energetic, not a clean neon sticker border.

Background
Use a dominantly vibrant red background. Around the edges and behind the subject, place large jagged abstract dark-gray shapes that resemble aggressive angular shards or stylized rough flame silhouettes.

Add only a few controlled white angular accents in the background for contrast. White should remain secondary; the background must still feel mostly red with dark gray impact shapes, not like a white explosion or busy radial burst.
Overall Look
The final result should feel like a bold premium poster illustration:
low-angle upward-looking grayscale vector portrait, dramatic sculpted face, black jagged hair, simple dark crew-neck t-shirt layered under a dark open collared shirt, red electric silhouette glow, red-dominant abstract background with dark gray shards and limited white accents.
Aspect ratio: 4:5 vertical.

prompts.title: The Low-Poly Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Create a stylized geometric low-poly portrait of the reference person using layered polygonal shapes with subtle depth and paper-cut texture. Maintain realistic proportions while transforming face into clean, angular facets. Person smiling naturally, wearing a modern casual outfit.
Important: Subject is in a standing pose, front-facing, with no body or head tilt, strict mid-chest up framing, like a profile picture pose.
Background: minimal soft beige/neutral geometric low-poly with slight gradient.
Lighting: soft studio light, gentle shadows to enhance 3D polygon depth, high detail, sharp focus, modern artistic look, centered composition, vertical format, 4:5 aspect ratio. No text, no watermark.
